item.description:
The wave moves like water now. The Breathe screen runs at your display's full refresh rate — the old cap could read as faintly stepped on sharp eyes.

Headphone messages that say the actual fix. "Connect headphones" covers a pair that's powered off; the call-quality message now points at the setting that frees them: give the Mac a different microphone in Sound settings. A just-connected pair also gets a moment to settle before Breathe takes no for an answer.
